semantics: Public English 149B: one a:b line, each part 1..5 digits 0..9/A..Z (values 0..35), leading zeroes allowed; integer radix >=2 with no upper cap, each digit <radix, hour 0..23 and minute 0..59. Unique increasing base tokens, or 0 for none / -1 for infinitely many. Horner evaluation checks bases through 59; any nonconstant part is at least its base. Constant valid parts give infinitely many bases. Independent inverse clock-value encoding cross-checks this.
